# A2A Bridge — ResonantOS add-on (agent2agent)

Expose the ResonantOS opencode delegation as an A2A 0.2.5 JSON-RPC server on
loopback: any A2A client can submit a text mission to the local opencode agent
and retrieve the result artifact, using the standard A2A task lifecycle,
without touching any other ResonantOS surface. Serve-only with operator-supplied
capability tokens; the bridge never dials beyond 127.0.0.1, and external
actions stay governed by the delegation packet's own boundary.

## Canonical links

- This repo: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-a2a-bridge
- Wire-format spec (A2A protocol): https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A

## Key facts

- ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on; validator: 0 errors / 0 warnings
- License: Apache-2.0
- Implements A2A 0.2.5: agent card, message/send, tasks/get, tasks/cancel;
  streaming and push notifications honestly declared false
- Loopback bind only; artifacts returned verbatim, never mutated or persisted

Relationship: community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — the delegation
surface it exposes is ResonantOS's own; the A2A protocol spec
(https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A) governs the wire format; this bridge is a
non-canonical exposure layer, and where anything here disagrees with either,
they win.
